BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 72 read with Section 71 of the Finance Act, No. 11 of 1963, I, MangalaSamaraweera, Minister of Finance and Mass Media, do by this Order, vest in the People’s Bank established under thePeople’s Bank Act, No. 29 of 1961, with effect from 12th February, Two Thousand and Nineteen, the properties described inthe Schedule hereto.
MANGALA SAMARAWEERA,Minister of Finance and Mass Media.Colombo,12th February, 2019.
